parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The pressure $p$ and volume $V$ of an ideal gas are related by $$pV = \frac{1}{3}Nm\langle c^2\rangle$$ where $N$ is the number of molecules, $m$ is the mass of a molecule and $\langle c^2\rangle$ is the mean-square speed of the molecules.

Use this equation to show that the mean kinetic energy $\langle E_K\rangle$ of a molecule is given by $$\langle E_K\rangle = \frac{3}{2}kT$$ where $k$ is the Boltzmann constant and $T$ is the thermodynamic temperature.
